structure_display.line: Drawn from PubChem's thimerosal record, which bonds the mercury to the sulfur that this record's one-line structure leaves apart.

why_it_matters.text: A mercury-containing preservative used since the 1930s in multi-dose vaccine vials and contact lens solutions, also known as thimerosal.

description: A mercury-containing preservative used since the 1930s in multi-dose vaccine vials and contact lens solutions, also known as thimerosal.

parts.label: The benzene ring
parts.sentence: Six carbons in a flat hexagon, sharing their electrons evenly around the ring. It is stable, flat and oily, and it stacks readily against other flat rings.
